The allow share rises as the posterior concentrates (the ask band narrows), then collapses at the t = 750 trust changepoint and recovers, exactly the Section 5 and Section 6 dynamics. Table 2: Simulation results, mean ± std over 6 seeds. Bold marks the decisive cells: the GP gateway is far more accurate, safer, and better calibrated than a no-correlation contextual baseline. The baseline’s larger automated fraction is not a virtue (left unbolded): it automates more only by auto-deciding cases it gets wrong.
